title: The Book of Enoch
author: R. H. Charles (trans)
description: R. H. Charles's translation of 1 Enoch introduces the Watchers, heavenly journeys and visions of judgement. This influential Jewish apocalyptic collection offers context for the religious imagination of the Second Temple period.
